Abstract.
    

Extending recent developments of Kra, Moreira, Richter and Roberson, we study infinite sumset patterns in  $U^{k}(\Phi)$ -uniform subsets of the integers, defined via the local uniformity seminorms introduced by Host and Kra. Szemerédi’s Theorem asserts that any subset of the natural numbers with positive density contains arbitrarily long arithmetic progressions. Different proofs of this theorem have played a central role in the development of additive combinatorics.
